summary: Plains GP Holdings (PAGP) via its subsidiary Plains All American Pipeline (PAA) sold Plains Midstream Canada ULC, holding PAA's Canadian NGL business, to Keyera Corp. for ~CAD $5.13 billion (~USD $3.76 billion) in cash, with net proceeds ~$3.3 billion after taxes/expenses to reduce leverage, including repaying a term loan and senior notes. The sale closed on May 12, 2026, per a June 2025 SPA, with transition services agreements and customary reps/warranties/indemnification backed by R&W insurance. Watch for post-closing adjustments and PAA's deleveraging execution; no risk-arb given the closing, but integration/asset performance remains key.
